content.short: Mask is a free and open source software developed and maintained by Dimension.
content.description: Mask extends the decentralized application ecosystem to mainstream social networks through a browser extension, providing a decentralized alternative for features Web 2.0 users expect. Users can access secure, decentralized social messaging, payment networks, file storage, and file sharing without leaving their favorite social platforms. By embedding Web3 privacy and capabilities directly into social media, Mask delivers enhanced control and privacy on networks like Facebook and Twitter, using open-source software.
